page.name: Page
rules: One white page throughout; ink text in Inter at 16px, leading 1.6.
Blue is the color of actions, labels and accents, never a ground behind a section or a gradient behind text.

column.name: Content column
rules: A 1200px frame with 40px of gutter (20px on phones); wide sections (a live table, a step-by-step, the closing card) take all of it.
Most sections sit in the 800px medium column (--ds-layout-medium): the hero, feature cards, pricing and the FAQ.

section.name: Section
rules: Generous air above each section (120px, 72px on phones) and nothing ruled between them; the last section before the footer keeps the same air below.
Sections are white; none sits on a colored ground.

section-heading.name: Section heading
section-heading.tailwind: font-display text-h2 font-medium tracking-tighter leading-display text-fg text-center text-balance
rules: Centered, display face at 500, 44px (32px on phones), tracked to -0.025em, leading 1.06.
Its description sits 16px under it, centered, 16px Inter at 64 percent ink; 48 to 56px of air before the content.
The closing card heading is the 48px step (h1).

section-description.name: Section description
section-description.tailwind: max-w-(--ds-layout-text) mx-auto text-body leading-lead text-fg-muted text-center
rules: 16px Inter at 64 percent ink, leading 1.55, centered under the heading, no wider than 576px.
One to three lines; it says what the section shows, plainly.

hero.name: Hero
rules: White and centered: a small squarish pill link, the headline, one line of lead, the blue key beside the white key, then the proof (a logo strip) and the product (a code window).
No colored ground and nothing behind the headline; any texture (the field of *s and @s) sits behind the code window and feathers out.

hero-title.name: Hero title
hero-title.tailwind: font-display text-hero font-medium tracking-hero leading-heading text-balance
rules: 54px display at 500, tracked to -0.03em, leading 1.02; 40px on phones.
Ink on white, two lines at most.

hero-subtitle.name: Hero subtitle
rules: 16px Inter at 64 percent ink, 12px under the headline.
One line where it fits; the actions follow 40px below.

eyebrow.name: Eyebrow
eyebrow.tailwind: inline-flex items-center px-3.5 py-1.5 border border-line-strong rounded-card bg-surface text-fg-muted font-sans text-body-sm font-medium tracking-snug normal-case transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:text-fg
rules: A squarish pill above the headline: 14px Inter at 500, 64 percent ink, a 16 percent ink border, 6px corners; it links somewhere real.
Sentence case, never caps; one short claim ("Buy from 4000+ stores").

card.name: Card
card.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-3 p-6 border border-line rounded-card bg-surface
rules: White, a 9 percent ink hairline, 6px corners and no drop.
A card that shows a product, a plan or a file is a window instead (window): 12px corners, a quiet bar and a soft drop.

card-raised.name: Raised card
card-raised.tailwind: px-3.5 pt-3 pb-3.5 border border-line rounded-control bg-surface shadow-raised
rules: A small card set on a picture (an order, a receipt): 8px corners, a hairline and a firmer drop.
Its header row is mono 11px at 64 percent ink with a status pill at the right.

window.name: Window
window.tailwind: flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-line-strong rounded-panel bg-surface shadow-card
rules: The brand's card: white, a 16 percent ink edge, 12px corners and a soft long drop, with a 36px bar on top.
Features, plans, live tables and code all sit in windows; the bar names them like files (pricing.plan, monitoring.live).

window-bar.name: Window bar
window-bar.tailwind: grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] items-center gap-3 min-h-9 pl-3.5 pr-3 border-b border-line bg-window-bar text-fg-muted font-mono text-bar
rules: 36px, mist ground, 11.5px mono at 64 percent ink, a 9 percent ink rule under it.
Left: a dimmed arrow; center: the window's name; right: the drawn [*] in blue, or the window's one action (Copy).

card-title.name: Card title
card-title.tailwind: font-display text-h4 font-medium tracking-tight leading-snug text-fg
rules: 20px display at 500, tracked tight, leading 1.2.
Its description is 16px Inter at 64 percent ink, 8px below.

body-text.name: Body text
rules: 16px Inter, leading 1.6, ink; secondary copy at 64 percent ink.
Lines no wider than about 70 characters.

caption.name: Caption
rules: 14px Inter at 64 percent ink: list details, footer links, small print (12px).
Hints and timestamps go fainter, 42 percent ink.

link.name: Link
link.tailwind: text-fg-brand no-underline transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:text-fg
rules: Inline links are blue with no underline; hover settles to ink.
Navigation and footer links are muted ink and turn ink on hover.

button-primary.name: Primary button

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), border-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), transform var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

button-primary.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4.5 rounded-control font-sans text-button font-medium leading-body whitespace-nowrap transition-[background-color,border-color,color,transform] duration-150 ease-out active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:transition-none border border-line-brand-edge bg-primary text-on-primary hover:bg-primary-hover
rules: The blue key: 40px tall, 18px of padding, 8px corners, 15px Inter at 500, a border a shade darker than the fill, flat (no shadow).
Hover lifts the blue toward white a shade; a press shrinks it to 97 percent.
One per view; the white key sits beside it for the second action.

button-secondary.name: Secondary button

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), border-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), transform var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

button-secondary.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4.5 rounded-control font-sans text-button font-medium leading-body whitespace-nowrap transition-[background-color,border-color,color,transform] duration-150 ease-out active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:transition-none border border-line-key bg-surface text-fg hover:bg-subtle
rules: The white key: ink text, a 16 percent ink border, flat.
Hover turns it mist; a press shrinks it.

button-on-brand.name: Button on the blue

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), border-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), transform var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

button-on-brand.tailwind: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-10 px-4.5 rounded-control font-sans text-button font-medium leading-body whitespace-nowrap transition-[background-color,border-color,color,transform] duration-150 ease-out active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:transition-none border border-line-key bg-white text-fg-brand hover:bg-subtle
rules: A white key with blue text, for the rare action that sits on a blue fill or on ink.
The page itself never has a blue ground; on white use the blue key.

header.name: Header
rules: No bar: three glass trays fixed over the page (the wordmark, the links, the Get started key), each its own pane, 64px tall.
At the top the links sit dead center; once the page scrolls the trays drop 12px and slide together (250ms, in-out), and the byline folds away.

header-action.name: Header action

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), transform var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

header-action.tailwind: inline-flex items-center gap-3.5 px-3.5 py-2 border border-line-brand-edge rounded-sm bg-primary text-on-primary font-sans text-body-sm leading-tight whitespace-nowrap transition-[background-color,transform] duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-primary-hover active:scale-[0.97]
rules: The header's one action is a small blue key (14px Inter, 6px corners) in its own glass tray.
Other header links are nav links in the middle tray.

nav-link.name: Nav link

css.transition: background-color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out), color var(--ds-duration-fast) var(--ds-easing-out)

nav-link.tailwind: flex items-center px-3.5 py-2 rounded-menu font-sans text-body-sm leading-tight text-fg-nav transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-wash-hover hover:text-fg aria-[current]:bg-surface aria-[current]:text-fg-brand aria-[current]:shadow-lit
rules: 14px Inter at 64 percent ink, 5px corners; hover is a 5 percent ink wash and ink text.
The current section is a white pill with blue text and a hairline lift, and it slides between links as the page scrolls (250ms, in-out).

nav-dock.name: Glass nav
nav-dock.tailwind: p-[3px] border border-line-glass rounded-control bg-glass bg-(image:--ds-glass-sheen) shadow-glass [backdrop-filter:var(--ds-glass-blur)] text-fg font-sans text-body-sm
rules: A tray of frosted glass: mostly white over a heavy blur, a 10 percent ink edge, a lit top edge, 8px corners and no drop.
Its links are nav links; the current one is the white pill.

chip.name: Tag
chip.tailwind: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 border-0 rounded-chip bg-blue-5 text-fg-brand font-mono text-caption tracking-normal normal-case leading-body
rules: A small tag: mono 11 to 12px, blue on the pale blue, 2px corners, sentence case ("Every merchant").
A status pill (Processing, Confirmed) is fully round, 10px at 600: mist and muted while waiting, sky and blue when done.

stat.name: Stat
stat.tailwind: font-display text-h2 font-medium tracking-hero leading-tight tabular-nums
rules: A figure in the 44px display step at 500 (a price), its unit beside it in 14px Inter at 64 percent ink.
Figures inside tables and pictures are mono 13px.

code-window.name: Code window
code-window.tailwind: overflow-hidden border border-line-strong rounded-panel bg-surface text-fg font-mono text-snippet leading-code shadow-card
rules: Code sits in a window: mono 13px, leading 1.75, keywords blue, strings deep blue, comments faint; a banded line is the pale blue.
Code that runs (a step, an install line) is the dark body: ink, text at 88 percent white, keywords pale blue, strings sky.
Long lines wrap and hang under their own indent instead of scrolling.

media-frame.name: Media panel
media-frame.tailwind: overflow-hidden border border-line-strong rounded-panel bg-surface shadow-card
rules: Screens, pictures and demos sit in a window (the same edge, corners and drop), never on a colored panel.
Pictures are small and flat, drawn from the page's own parts: hairlines on white with blue as the only voice.

table.name: Table
rules: 14px Inter rows at 16px of padding with a 9 percent ink rule under each; heads 12px Inter at 64 percent ink, normal weight.
Figures (rates, durations) are mono 13px; hovered rows turn mist. No zebra stripes, no vertical rules.

faq.name: FAQ
rules: Questions in an 800px list: 16px Inter, 20px of padding, a 9 percent ink rule between; a drawn plus at the right turns 45 degrees and blue when open.
Hovered and open rows take the pale blue on a card inset 3px, and hide the rules on both edges.
The answer is 15px Inter at 64 percent ink, fading up 4px in 200ms; one open at a time.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.tailwind: flex gap-[2px] p-[3px] border border-line-glass rounded-control bg-glass shadow-glass
rules: A tray like the header's: 3px inset, 8px corners; tabs are 14px Inter at 64 percent ink with 5px corners.
The selected tab is a white pill with blue text and a hairline lift that slides between tabs (250ms, in-out).
Tabs on ink (an install box) are an underline: white 2px under the selected, the rest white at 50 percent.

input.name: Input
input.tailwind: h-9 px-3 border border-line-field rounded-control bg-surface text-fg font-sans text-body-sm placeholder:text-fg-faint outline-none transition-[border-color] duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:border-brand aria-invalid:border-danger
rules: 36px fields: a 16 percent ink border, 8px corners, 14px Inter, placeholder at 42 percent ink.
Focus turns the border blue (no glow); invalid fields use the danger border. Labels are 14px Inter above the control.

logo-strip.name: Merchant line

css.mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--ds-color-black) 14%, var(--ds-color-black) 86%, transparent)

rules: Bare marks in gray, one row, no tiles: square marks 20px tall, long wordmarks held to 84px wide, 44px apart.
The row drifts left slowly (linear, about 100s a loop), fades out at both ends and holds while the pointer rests on it; under reduced motion it stays put and scrolls by hand.

footer.name: Footer
footer.tailwind: border-t border-line bg-surface text-fg font-sans text-body-sm
rules: On the page's own white under a hairline: the wordmark and a line about the product at the left, three link columns at the right (heads 13px display at 500, links 14px at 64 percent ink).
Small print in 12px under a second hairline, then the name set as large as the page allows, as a faint outline that lights blue under the pointer.

menu-panel.name: Menu panel
menu-panel.tailwind: rounded-control border border-line bg-surface p-1 font-sans text-body-sm text-fg shadow-floating outline-none
rules: A white panel: a 9 percent ink hairline, 8px corners and a soft drop; rows of 14px Inter.
Keep the existing interaction, placement, keyboard focus, disabled states and selection.

menu-item.name: Menu item
menu-item.tailwind: rounded-menu px-3 py-2 font-sans text-body-sm leading-snug text-fg outline-none data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-40 data-[highlighted]:bg-wash-hover data-[highlighted]:text-fg
rules: Rows of 14px Inter in ink, 5px corners; the highlighted row takes a 5 percent ink wash, as a nav link does.
Keep the existing interaction, placement, keyboard focus, disabled states and selection.

glass-menu.name: Glass menu
glass-menu.tailwind: rounded-control border border-line-glass bg-glass bg-(image:--ds-glass-sheen) p-1 font-sans text-body-sm text-fg shadow-floating [backdrop-filter:var(--ds-glass-blur)] outline-none
rules: A menu that drops from a glass tray is glass too: mostly white over a heavy blur, a 10 percent ink edge.
Keep the existing interaction, placement, keyboard focus, disabled states and selection.

glass-menu-item.name: Glass menu item
glass-menu-item.tailwind: rounded-menu px-3.5 py-2 font-sans text-body-sm leading-tight text-fg-nav outline-none data-[highlighted]:bg-wash-glass-hover data-[highlighted]:text-fg
rules: Rows like nav links: 14px Inter at 64 percent ink; hover is a 5 percent ink wash and ink text.
Keep the existing interaction, placement, keyboard focus, disabled states and selection.

popover-panel.name: Popover panel
popover-panel.tailwind: rounded-control border border-line bg-surface p-4 font-sans text-body-sm text-fg shadow-floating outline-none
rules: A white panel: a 9 percent ink hairline, 8px corners and a soft drop; rows of 14px Inter.
Keep the existing interaction, placement, keyboard focus, disabled states and selection.
